channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Fifa define equipe de arbitragem para semifinal entre França e Espanha
item.description: FIFA has appointed the refereeing team for the 2026 World Cup semifinal between France and Spain, with Salvadoran Ivan Barton as the main referee. Barton, 35, has officiated three matches in this tournament and was the first to apply the 'Vini Jr. Law', sending off Paraguay's Miguel Almirón for a gesture. The match will take place on Tuesday, July 14 at 4:00 PM Brasília time.

item.title: Aprovação e desaprovação de Lula empatam em 47%, diz Nexus
item.description: A Nexus survey released on July 13, 2026, shows a technical tie in approval and disapproval of Lula's government, both at 47%. The poll interviewed 2,003 people with a 2-point margin of error and 95% confidence level, registered with the TSE as BR-07981/2026, and was funded by BTG Pactual.

item.title: BTG/Nexus: Lula perde fôlego no 1º turno, mas mantém empate técnico no 2º
item.description: Lula lost two percentage points in the first round of the BTG/Nexus 2026 poll, yet still holds a numerical lead over Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL). In the head-to-head runoff scenario, the race remains stable and within the margin of error, indicating a technical tie. The decline suggests a loss of momentum, but not a reversal of his current advantage.

item.title: BTG/Nexus: 64% ouviram falar das críticas de Michelle a Flávio Bolsonaro; 35% não ouviram
item.description: BTG/Nexus poll shows 64% of voters have heard about Michelle Bolsonaro's criticisms of Flávio Bolsonaro, while 35% said they were unaware of the dispute. The survey, released Monday, highlights the visibility of the internal conflict within the PL party.

item.title: BTG/Nexus: governo Lula tem aprovação e desaprovação de 47%
item.description: The BTG/Nexus poll shows a technical tie in approval of Lula's government, with 47% approval and 47% disapproval, while 6% did not know or did not respond. Public security is the top concern cited (29%), followed by corruption (24%) and public health (23%). Government evaluation shows 35% positive (excellent/good), 24% regular, and 33% negative.

item.title: BTG/Nexus: 46% dizem que não votariam em Lula de jeito nenhum; 50% dizem o mesmo sobre Flávio
item.description: BTG/Nexus poll shows 50% of voters say they would never vote for Senator Flávio Bolsonaro for president, compared to 46% who say the same about Lula. Flávio's rejection rate changed by only 1 percentage point since the June 29 survey, remaining within the poll's 2-point margin of error.

item.title: Kassab diz que Lula vence Flávio, mas perde para Caiado
item.description: Gilberto Kassab, national president of the PSD, stated that Lula would defeat Flávio Bolsonaro in a runoff but lose to Ronaldo Caiado, the PSD’s pre-candidate. He noted Flávio remains in the race due to strong polling numbers, despite internal campaign conflicts, citing Michelle Bolsonaro’s influence as a destabilizing factor. Kassab described Caiado as a 'moderate right' politician with administrative experience and dialogue capacity, emphasizing the PSD’s independent 'pure ticket' strategy resisting both bolsonarism and petismo, without requiring state-level candidates to align with the presidential ticket.

item.title: Polarização marca primeiro semestre na Câmara de Vereadores de Niterói
item.description: The first half of 2026 in Niterói's City Council was marked by strong polarization between the governing coalition and opposition, with debates over gender identity, Carnival, and honors dominating sessions. Despite tensions, legislative output slightly decreased, with 290 bills filed (down from 306 in 2025) and 17 executive messages sent (down from 20 last year). The clashes reflect early electoral maneuvers for the October elections, as at least five council members are expected to run for state or federal office.

item.title: “Não acredito que esse cara seja o Lula”, diz Daciolo
item.description: Former federal deputy Cabo Daciolo (Mobiliza), a pre-candidate for president in 2026, stated in an interview that he does not believe the person publicly appearing as President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva is actually Lula, questioning his identity based on his good physical condition at age 80. He also reiterated his belief that the 2018 stabbing attack on Jair Bolsonaro was a staged event, linking his claims to conspiracy theories such as the 'New World Order' and Freemasonry. Daciolo provided no evidence for his allegations.

item.title: União e PP se reúnem nesta semana, em meio a incertezas que rondam a candidatura de Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: Leaders of the União and PP parties are meeting this week to discuss uncertainties surrounding Flávio Bolsonaro's presidential candidacy, particularly due to fears of new damaging revelations involving the senator and figures like banker Daniel Vorcaro. While the federation officially denies any debate over withdrawal, reserved leaders admit that delays in choosing a running mate and potential scandals could strain the alliance. The PL has confirmed its national convention for July 25 at Mercado Pago Hall in São Paulo to formally nominate Flávio, with Valdemar Costa Neto publicly advocating for Teresa Cristina as his running mate.

item.title: A Nobreza do Amor: confira resumo da semana da novela das seis
item.description: In episodes 95 to 98 of the 6 p.m. novela, Alika reveals Omar is coming to Brazil and wants to marry her, while Dumi, Akin, and Ladisa attempt to steal the king’s jewels, facing pursuit and loss. Virginia announces a hunger strike after being confronted, and Kênia is imprisoned by Jendal for protecting rebels. Fátima continues manipulating Salma, as tensions rise over secrets, betrayals, and romantic and political conflicts.

item.title: Os sinais de bastidores sobre a política econômica em um eventual quarto mandato de Lula
item.description: Lula signals to allies that he wants a fourth term focused on leaving a legacy, with significant investments in critical minerals, energy transition, and full-time education, while also expressing concern over rising public debt and seeking a more effective strategy to curb indebtedness and improve fiscal trajectory. Internal government debate centers on whether to launch a potential new term with a stronger fiscal austerity signal in the first year to ease market pressure, though the 2027 LDO project shows only a 1% above-inflation spending growth — largely due to new precatório rules, not structural adjustment. The lack of clarity persists as allies tread carefully three months before the election, fearing backlash from prematurely signaling measures.

item.title: A encruzilhada de Flávio Bolsonaro na definição dos novos candidatos ao Senado no Rio
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro, the PL's pre-candidate for president, faces a crossroads in defining his Senate slate in Rio de Janeiro, with strategic decisions that could impact his ticket and the state's political landscape. The subscriber-exclusive article highlights internal pressures and ongoing negotiations to select the names that will represent him in the Senate race.

item.title: Lula começa a semana em São Paulo
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva visits ethanol and biodiesel laboratories at the Mauá Institute of Technology in São Caetano do Sul, SP, and the Aeronautics and Space Institute in São José dos Campos, SP, to learn about ethanol-powered gas turbine projects for energy generation. He will make two press announcements during the agenda, with Vice President Geraldo Alckmin and Minister Alexandre Silveira present. The visit concludes at 16:20 with departure back to Brasília.

item.title: Pode ser presidente quem vive correndo para o colo do pai?
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro was named by Jair Bolsonaro as a pre-candidate for the Presidency of Brazil in two letters, one from December 2025 and another recent one, despite accusations of receiving R$16 million from Daniel Vorcaro to fund a film glorifying his father and failing to provide promised explanations. The former president, convicted of coup attempt and under house arrest, openly backs his son as a spokesperson to 'rescue Brazil', while Michelle Bolsonaro accused Flavio of treating her harshly. The text implies Flavio consistently seeks his father’s protection when facing scandals.

item.title: Um ano após tarifaço, governo não vê caminho para reverter taxas
item.description: One year after the U.S. announced tariffs on Brazilian goods, the Lula administration still sees no path to reverse the duties, which now total 50% and face an additional 25% increase on more products. The tariffs are tied to Trump’s criticism of the Bolsonaro trial in Brazil’s Supreme Court, making the dispute both economic and political. The Brazilian government is now preparing a contingency plan amid the threat of new surcharges.

item.title: Governo Lula entra em semana decisiva de tarifaço sem acordo à vista
item.description: The Lula government faces a decisive week regarding potential new U.S. tariffs on Brazilian exports, with little expectation of reversal. Despite ongoing negotiations, presidential advisors see slim chances of agreement, as the USTR views Brazilian practices as unfair. Trump’s decision is expected to be announced on Wednesday, July 15, following a final meeting between USTR representative Greer and Brazilian ministers.

item.title: Governo tenta ganhar tempo com MP para adiar debate sobre dívida rural
item.description: The federal government presented a Provisional Measure to partially meet agribusiness demands regarding rural debt renegotiation, aiming to buy time amid congressional deadlock. The proposal seeks to avoid approval of PL 5.122/2023 in the Senate's terms, which would entail a fiscal cost of R$140 billion over 13 years, pushing the debate to August after the parliamentary recess. Finance Minister Dario Durigan stated the solution will come via the MP, following failed Senate negotiations and risks of presidential veto or Supreme Court action.

item.title: Tracking anima campanha de Flávio Bolsonaro; aliados de Lula minimizam
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) led Lula by 0.7 percentage points in an internal tracking poll conducted by his campaign on Saturday (July 11), representing a technical tie. Previously, Lula had held a numerical advantage. Lula’s allies downplayed the result, citing internal government polls showing the president eight points ahead and predicting Bolsonaro’s numbers will worsen once the campaign intensifies.

item.title: Financiadora de Dark Horse foi maior pagadora de empresa ligada a PCC
item.description: Entre Investimentos e Participações, the company that financed the Dark Horse film about Jair Bolsonaro, made 14 transfers totaling R$28 million to ACX ITC Tecnologia between August 2024 and April 2025, a company investigated for money laundering linked to the PCC. The relationship is under investigation by São Paulo Civil Police, which identified ACX ITC as part of a drug trafficking money laundering network. Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) is mentioned as a possible beneficiary of the financing channeled through Entre Investimentos, linked to banker Daniel Vorcaro.

item.title: O fator inédito da eleição em SP que explica temor do PT sobre Tarcísio eleito no 1º turno
item.description: The 2026 São Paulo gubernatorial race will be unprecedented, featuring only two candidates from major parties: incumbent governor Tarcísio de Freitas (Republicanos) and former São Paulo mayor Fernando Haddad (PT). Historically, the state has had three or more competitive candidates in the first round since direct elections resumed in 1982, but a last-minute shift before party conventions narrowed the field to just two, raising PT fears that Tarcísio could win in the first round.

item.title: Malafaia sugere vice a Flávio e relembra conselho que deu a Bolsonaro
item.description: Pastor Silas Malafaia advised Flávio Bolsonaro to select a non-evangelical woman from Northeast Brazil as his vice-presidential running mate for the 2026 elections. He also recalled giving similar counsel to Jair Bolsonaro in the past. The article is subscriber-only and requires registration for full access.

item.title: Lindbergh aciona STF e pede revogação da prisão domiciliar de Bolsonaro
item.description: Federal Deputy Lindbergh Farias (PT-RJ) filed a petition with the STF requesting the revocation of Jair Bolsonaro's house arrest and his return to a closed regime, alleging that Bolsonaro used his son Flávio as a 'mouthpiece' to promote the son's presidential pre-candidacy in a YouTube livestream, violating court orders prohibiting direct or indirect use of social media. The request includes a R$100,000 fine against Flávio Bolsonaro, preservation of the stream by YouTube, Federal Police forensic analysis, and referral to the PGR for potential criminal liability investigation.

item.title: Entrevista: 'Flávio está com problemas, mas não o vejo saindo da disputa', diz Gilberto Kassab
item.description: Gilberto Kassab, national president of the PSD, stated he does not see Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) withdrawing from the 2026 presidential race despite internal party challenges. He also said he will not demand support from PSD gubernatorial candidates for Ronaldo Caiado’s ticket, criticized the Bolsonaro family’s 'tariff hike', and advocated for ending parliamentary amendments, emphasizing the independence of majoritarian campaigns.

item.title: Olimpia x Flamengo: na pré-lista, Lino é destaque do Rubro-Negro
item.description: Flamengo will face Olimpia in a friendly on July 17 at Arena Mané Garrincha, with tickets starting at R$59. Samuel Lino, a key player for the Rubro-Negro, had a standout 2026 season with 32 appearances, 6 goals, and 9 assists, and was included in Carlo Ancelotti's 55-player preliminary list for the World Cup, having also been called up to the Brazil national team in August 2025.

item.title: União-PP critica ausência de Flávio e prevê isolamento: "Só com o PL"
item.description: Members of the União-PP federation complain they have not been contacted by Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) or his allies, including Valdemar Costa Neto and Rogério Marinho, to discuss political articulation or alliance. Despite existing tensions between PP leader Ciro Nogueira and Flávio Bolsonaro, little effort has been made to resolve differences, risking the pre-candidate’s isolation with only PL support. Resistance to Flávio’s project is expected to spread across other Centrão parties.

item.title: Brasil no divã: como as eleições e a Copa mobilizam os sentimentos no país - O Assunto #1759
item.description: The podcast examines how the World Cup and the 2026 elections mobilize collective emotions in Brazil, revealing social divisions and feelings such as euphoria, anger, and belonging. Psychoanalyst Vera Iaconelli analyzes the 'vira-lata complex' and national arrogance, discussing sports grief after Brazil's elimination and the need for the country to confront its historical inequalities through self-reflection.

item.title: Ángel Víctor Torres: “En 2027 puede haber 500.000 nuevos nacionalizados con derecho a voto”
item.description: Minister Ángel Víctor Torres defended the so-called 'grandchildren's law,' which could grant voting rights to up to 500,000 new citizens by 2027, dismissing PP allegations of census manipulation. He also addressed corruption cases affecting the PSOE and the Supreme Court’s decision to release Víctor de Aldama due to cooperation with justice, despite Aldama’s attempt to link Torres to a bribery scheme.

item.title: EUA decidem na quarta sobre tarifaço ao Brasil; governo Lula aguarda 'dimensão da decisão' para calibrar reação
item.description: The Brazilian government is awaiting the U.S. decision on whether to impose 25% and 12.5% tariffs on Brazilian exports, set for Wednesday (15), to calibrate its response. While preparing for the likely confirmation of the tariffs, the Lula administration believes a modified annex with additional exceptions may be included, due to pressure from 43 U.S. companies reliant on Brazilian imports. If confirmed, Brazil plans to respond with official 'indignation', labeling the move 'unacceptable' and unjustified, arguing that Brazil’s tariff structure already favors U.S. exports.

item.title: Líder de caminhoneiros anuncia paralisação da categoria nesta segunda
item.description: The president of Abrava, Wallace Landim (Chorão), announced that truckers will stage a port shutdown starting at midnight on Monday (July 13) to pressure Senate President Davi Alcolumbre into bringing MP 1.343 to a vote, which establishes a national minimum freight floor of R$ 5,000 and strengthens oversight mechanisms. The union demands the vote occur before Thursday (July 16), when the measure expires, or it will lapse. Landim stated the strike is a direct response to Senate inaction and will continue until the MP is approved.

item.title: Flávio, Augusto do Anjos e reaças: entre desastre e esperança ao menos
item.description: The text discusses Flávio Bolsonaro’s 2026 presidential candidacy, emphasizing his reliance on two letters of support from his father, Jair Bolsonaro, and the lack of backing from parties like União Brasil, PP, and Republicanos. Using literary references to Augusto dos Anjos and Wim Wenders’ film, the author suggests the election is both imminent and distant, with risks of institutional disaster if Flávio wins, stemming from an increasingly radicalized and privatized far-right, even in Freudian terms.

item.title: Lula cumpre agenda em SP nesta segunda-feira
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva is carrying out an agenda in São Paulo on Monday, the 13th, with visits to São Caetano do Sul and São José dos Campos, where he will announce initiatives and tour local institutions. The schedule includes a 10 a.m. commitment at the Interior Police Division, reinforcing public security actions. These activities are part of a statewide tour aimed at strengthening ties with regional leaders and presenting federal government proposals.

item.title: Os 4 pontos em comum entre Renan Santos, do Missão, e o argentino Javier Milei
item.description: Renan Santos (Missão), a pre-candidate for president, shares four ideological points with Javier Milei: economic ultra-liberalism (lower taxes and bureaucracy), positioning as an anti-system candidate despite being in a formal party, strong support among voters aged 16–24 (37.9% in polls), and conservatism on social issues, including opposition to the LGBT+ agenda, gender equality, and racial equality policies.

item.title: O custo eleitoral difuso de ignorar a opinião pública sobre a farra das emendas
item.description: Despite 82% of Brazilians associating parliamentary amendments with corruption, according to Genial/Quaest, Congress continues allocating tens of billions via Pix, bench, and individual amendments with opaque criteria. Even after the demise of the 'secret budget,' Lula released a record R$ 34 billion in amendments during an election year, ignoring public demand for technical, transparent use of funds. The lack of electoral accountability for amendment-related scandals perpetuates a cycle where politicians benefit from their base while taxpayers bear the cost of opacity.

item.title: Flávio diz que procurará China para negociar taxa de 55% sobre carnes
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) announced he will seek negotiations with the Chinese government to reverse the 55% tariff on Brazilian beef, which he blames on President Lula. He criticized the federal administration for alleged incompetence in defending Brazil’s trade interests, linking the Chinese measure to Lula’s responsibility. The remarks were made during a live social media broadcast amid rising trade tensions with the U.S., which threatens a 25% tariff on Brazilian goods.

item.title: Valdemar: “Bolsonaro é que tem os votos”
item.description: Valdemar Costa Neto, president of the PL, stated that Jair Bolsonaro holds the electoral capital of the right and that his letter strengthens Flávio Bolsonaro’s presidential pre-candidacy in 2026. He emphasized that Bolsonaro’s support is decisive to consolidate the bolsonarist ticket.

item.title: “Não aguento mais mineiros enrolados”, diz Cunha sobre emendas
item.description: The Federal Police intercepted dialogues in which former deputy Eduardo Cunha complains about Minas mayors and requests the redirection of a parliamentary amendment from Governador Valadares to another municipality, suggesting irregular allocation of public funds. The messages, exchanged with servant Mariângela Fialek (Tuca), show Cunha directly coordinating the distribution of at least 29 health committee amendments worth R$ 6.1 million. Minister Flávio Dino ordered the blocking of R$ 6.1 million in Cunha’s assets, who is a pre-candidate for the Chamber of Deputies from Minas Gerais.

item.title: Cunha queixou-se de “mineiros enrolados” em diálogo sobre emendas
item.description: Former federal deputy Eduardo Cunha (Republicanos) was intercepted by the Federal Police complaining about 'tangled' miners from Minas Gerais and requesting the redirection of a R$ 6.1 million parliamentary amendment originally intended for Governador Valadares to another municipality, in messages with aide Mariângela Fialek (Tuca). The communications are part of an investigation into alleged irregular allocation of public funds, with the PF stating Cunha directly coordinated the distribution of at least 29 health-related amendments worth R$ 6.1 million. Although Supreme Court Minister Flávio Dino ordered the freezing of R$ 6.1 million in Cunha’s assets, his defense denies wrongdoing and pledges to challenge the ruling.

item.title: Nardoni marca de cabeça e faz 2º gol do Grêmio contra o Cruzeiro no DF
item.description: In a friendly match between Grêmio and Cruzeiro at Arena Mané Garrincha in Brasília, Grêmio won 2-1. The second goal was scored by midfielder Nardoni, who headed in unmarked inside the box after a cross from Pavón in the 37th minute of the first half. The match was broadcast by Metrópoles Sports, which has been promoting various sporting events throughout 2026.

item.title: Republicanos nega que tenha fechado apoio a Flávio Bolsonaro e indica ‘neutralidade’ nas eleições
item.description: The Republicans party denied having closed support for Flávio Bolsonaro's presidential bid, stating that talks with him were inconclusive and occurred over a month ago. Internal surveys show voter frustration with Bolsonaro's pre-candidacy and a preference for neutrality, while support for Lula is completely ruled out. The party's final direction will be decided at its National Convention.

item.title: Lula quer ato em São Bernardo para iniciar campanha
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) is expected to officially launch his 2026 re-election campaign in São Bernardo do Campo (SP), the city where he began his union and political career. The symbolic event aims to reinforce his working-class roots and energize his electoral base.

item.title: Moraes manda soltar PM preso em operação da PF e impõe uso de tornozeleira eletrônica
item.description: Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes ordered the release of military police officer Antônio Gomes da Silva Neto, replacing preventive detention with electronic monitoring and passport surrender. He also granted house arrest to Senate pre-candidate Márcio Canella under the same conditions and demanded the Rio de Janeiro Military Police explain the origin of two seized firearms within five days. The PF operation, part of Mission Redentor II, targets money laundering through gas stations, with evidence of R$ 7.6 billion moved over six years.

item.title: CBF posta vídeo sobre futuro ciclo da Seleção Brasileira; assista
item.description: The CBF posted a video on social media on July 12, 2026, reflecting on Brazil's elimination from the 2026 World Cup and announcing the start of a new cycle aimed at the 2030 World Cup. The video features emotional images of players like Neymar and Casemiro saying goodbye, as well as young talents such as Endrick, Estêvão, and Raphinha, along with coach Carlo Ancelotti, delivering a message of resilience, hard work, and hope for the future.

item.title: Ayrton Senna é reconhecido oficialmente como Herói da Pátria
item.description: Ayrton Senna was officially recognized as a National Hero with the inclusion of his name in the Book of Heroes and Heroines of the Fatherland, sanctioned by Law No. 15,447/2026, signed by President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva. The three-time Formula 1 world champion, who died in 1994 at age 34, was honored not only for his motorsport achievements but also for the educational work of the Ayrton Senna Institute. The proposal originated from Senator Marcos Pontes (PL-SP) and was approved by Congress before presidential sanction.

item.title: Em vídeo sem camisa na esteira, Lula exibe rotina de exercícios físicos e incentiva cuidados com a saúde
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva shared a video on his social media showing his physical exercise routine, including 40 minutes on a treadmill, with 10 minutes of running at 8 km/h. He noted that he can now perform exercises he couldn’t do in 2003 at age 57, and urged the public to adopt healthy habits, such as daily 20- to 40-minute walks, emphasizing that health is the most important goal to enjoy life with family and pets.

item.title: Marcos Pereira nega vaga ao STF como condição para apoiar Flávio
item.description: Republicans party leader Marcos Pereira denied conditioning the party's support for pre-candidate Flávio Bolsonaro on a Supreme Court nomination. He stated that the decision on presidential support will be made at the national convention, noting preliminary surveys show frustration with Flávio's pre-candidacy and a preference for neutrality, ruling out support for Lula. Senator Rogério Marinho, Flávio's campaign coordinator, also categorically denied that the party's support is conditional on STF appointments.

item.title: Deputado do PT pede ao STF que Bolsonaro seja transferido para regime fechado e Flávio pague R$ 100 mil de multa após carta
item.description: Deputy Lindbergh Farias (PT-RJ) asked the STF to revoke Jair Bolsonaro's house arrest and transfer him to a closed regime, after the former president had a letter read by his son Flávio Bolsonaro, violating the ban on expressing himself via social media. The petition also seeks a R$100,000 fine against Flávio for 'an act attentive to the dignity of justice'.

item.title: Cunha teve aval da Presidência da Câmara para desviar recursos, diz PF
item.description: The Federal Police found that Chamber employee Mariângela Fialek (Tuca) had full approval from the Presidency of the House to divert R$6.15 million in amendments favoring former deputy Eduardo Cunha, according to a decision by Supreme Court Minister Flávio Dino. The funds were directed to municipalities in Minas Gerais, where Cunha plans to run for federal deputy in 2026, and he acted as a 'relevant vector' in defining the allocations, bypassing formal procedures. The investigation reveals a scheme of promiscuity in the secret budget, with messages showing direct coordination between Cunha and Tuca.

item.title: Com Carlos Vinícius, Grêmio está escalado para encarar o Cruzeiro no DF
item.description: Grêmio will face Cruzeiro this Sunday (July 12) at 5 p.m. at Arena Mané Garrincha in Brasília, with Carlos Vinícius starting in attack. The announced lineup includes Gabriel Grando, Pavon, Gustavo Martins, Kannemann (captain), Caio Paulista, Juan Nardoni, Villasanti, Gabriel Mec, Tetê, Amuzu and Carlos Vinícius, with substitutes such as Thiago Beltrame and Gabriel Menegon. The match is part of the Metrópoles Sports project, which has hosted several sporting events in 2026.

item.title: Ouça jingle em homenagem a Lula com aceno a evangélicos
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva shared an evangelical jingle titled 'Tapete Vermelho' on his official Instagram account, composed by Aline Paula (portrayed as AI character Lina Luz), which praises his political journey, including his imprisonment during Operation Lava Jato, international recognition, and Northeastern roots. Lula expressed gratitude for the tribute, noting the video had previously been circulated by the PT and his supporters.
